decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the commercial use of the ground floor known as A1.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans PR37957/01 and PR37957/02 submitted on 4th August 2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 6 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Erection of a ground floor rear extension to the shop.
